transcript:
Tom: Are you okay, Jerry?
Jerry: I feel a bit tired.
Tom: Doctor said you are fine.
Jerry: I will get better soon.
Tom: Do you need anything now?
Jerry: Just stay here with me.
Tom: I will not leave you.
Jerry: Thank you, my friend Tom.
